meta.title: Aseer Mosque, illustrative BIM dataset
meta.disclaimer: Synthetic data generated for demonstration. Specifications, codes, costs and dates are plausible for the Saudi market but are not surveyed, as-built or quoted values.
meta.source: Element names and geometry from the Revit-derived GLB; properties from scripts/build-bim-data.mjs
meta.costBasis: Indicative 2025 KSA supply + install ranges; verify with a quantity surveyor

site.name: Aseer Mosque (illustrative)
site.region: Aseer Region, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia
site.occupancy: SBC 201 Group A-3 (Assembly: place of religious worship)
site.owner: Ministry of Islamic Affairs, Dawah and Guidance (assumed typical owner)

WL-PLINTH.name: Plinth / boundary wall, stone-chip render
WL-PLINTH.nameAr: جدار قاعدة / سور بتشطيب حجر مجروش
WL-PLINTH.construction: 200 mm hollow concrete block on RC strip footing, 20 mm cement plaster, stone-chip (granolite) textured render
WL-PLINTH.material: Concrete masonry units, cement plaster, stone-chip render
WL-PLINTH.maintenance: Annual visual inspection; clean render and repair cracks every 5 years

WL-TILE.name: External wall, porcelain tile cladding
WL-TILE.construction: 200 mm insulated hollow concrete block, 50 mm XPS insulation, cement plaster, 10 mm porcelain tiles on adhesive with stainless steel safety clips
WL-TILE.material: Insulated concrete block, XPS, porcelain tiles
WL-TILE.maintenance: Annual inspection of tile adhesion and joints; wash facade every 6 months (dust)

WL-STONE.name: External wall, brown natural stone / tile cladding
WL-STONE.nameAr: جدار خارجي مكسو بحجر طبيعي بني
WL-STONE.construction: 200 mm insulated hollow concrete block, 50 mm XPS insulation, 30 mm brown natural stone (or stone-look porcelain) on stainless steel anchors, Asiri-style finish
WL-STONE.material: Insulated concrete block, XPS, natural stone cladding
WL-STONE.maintenance: Annual anchor and joint inspection; reseal joints every 8 years

CR-GRC.name: GRC cornice band
CR-GRC.construction: Glass-fibre reinforced concrete (GRC) cornice, stainless steel fixings, factory-painted
CR-GRC.maintenance: Annual inspection of fixings; repaint every 7 years

GZ-FIXED.name: Fixed window 406 x 1220 mm, aluminium, double glazed
GZ-FIXED.nameAr: نافذة ثابتة ألمنيوم زجاج مزدوج ٤٠٦×١٢٢٠ مم
GZ-FIXED.construction: Thermally broken aluminium frame, 6 mm low-e + 12 mm air + 6 mm clear double glazing
GZ-FIXED.maintenance: Clean glass every 3 months (dust); check seals annually

WN-ARCH.name: Arched mosque window, aluminium with decorative grille
WN-ARCH.nameAr: نافذة مسجد مقوسة ألمنيوم مع مشربية زخرفية
WN-ARCH.construction: Arched thermally broken aluminium window, low-e double glazing, external decorative aluminium grille (mashrabiya pattern)
WN-ARCH.maintenance: Clean glass and grille every 3 months; check seals and drainage annually

DR-SINGLE.name: Single flush door, solid-core wood
DR-SINGLE.construction: Solid-core hardwood-veneer door leaf, hardwood frame, stainless steel ironmongery
DR-SINGLE.maintenance: Adjust and lubricate hardware every 6 months

DR-SLIDING.name: Double sliding door, 2-panel wood
DR-SLIDING.construction: Two solid-core wood panels on concealed top-hung sliding track
DR-SLIDING.maintenance: Clean and adjust track every 6 months

RF-FLAT.name: Flat roof, 125 mm RC slab, inverted insulated system
RF-FLAT.nameAr: سقف مسطح خرساني ١٢٥ مم مع عزل مقلوب
RF-FLAT.construction: 125 mm RC slab, screed to falls, bituminous waterproofing membrane, 75 mm XPS insulation, geotextile, 50 mm concrete tiles
RF-FLAT.maintenance: Inspect membrane and clear roof drains before the Aseer rainy season (annual)

DM-MAIN.name: Main prayer hall dome
DM-MAIN.construction: RC dome shell on ring beam, insulation, green glazed ceramic tile finish outside, decorative GRC / plaster inside
DM-MAIN.material: Reinforced concrete, glazed ceramic tiles, GRC
DM-MAIN.maintenance: Annual inspection of tiles and waterproofing; check crescent finial fixings

DM-FINIAL.name: Minaret cap with crescent finial
DM-FINIAL.construction: GRC minaret cap with gold-finish stainless steel crescent (hilal) finial
DM-FINIAL.maintenance: Annual fixings inspection; lightning protection test

FL-SITE.uniformat: G2020 Parking Lots / G2030 Pedestrian Paving
FL-SITE.name: Site hardscape: asphalt driveways and plaza paving
FL-SITE.construction: Asphalt wearing course on base course for driveways and parking; interlocking concrete pavers / stone paving on the plaza
standards: MOMRAH municipal road and paving specifications
FL-SITE.maintenance: Annual inspection; reseal asphalt cracks and relevel pavers as needed

RL-SS.name: Stainless steel ramp / stair railing
RL-SS.construction: Grade 316 stainless steel posts and balusters, satin finish, anchored to concrete
RL-SS.maintenance: Clean every 3 months; check anchors annually

RL-TOP.name: Handrail, 40 mm circular stainless steel
RL-TOP.nameAr: مقبض درابزين دائري ستانلس ستيل ٤٠ مم
RL-TOP.construction: 40 mm diameter grade 316 stainless steel tube handrail

ST-EXT.name: External entrance steps, granite treads
ST-EXT.construction: RC stepped slab with 30 mm flamed (anti-slip) granite treads and risers
ST-EXT.maintenance: Annual inspection of treads and nosings

PS-TENSILE.name: Car park shade, 2 bays, tensile membrane
PS-TENSILE.nameAr: مظلة مواقف سيارات لموقفين بقماش مشدود
PS-TENSILE.construction: Galvanized, powder-coated steel cantilever frame with UV-stabilised PVDF-coated PVC membrane
PS-TENSILE.maintenance: Annual membrane tension and fixings check; wash membrane every 6 months

LP-6M.name: Area lighting pole 6 m, LED
LP-6M.nameAr: عمود إنارة ٦ م مع كشاف LED
LP-6M.construction: Hot-dip galvanized steel pole on concrete base, LED luminaire with photocell
LP-6M.maintenance: Quarterly lamp and photocell check; galvanizing inspection every 5 years

LP-8M.name: Street lighting pole 8 m, LED
LP-8M.nameAr: عمود إنارة شارع ٨ م مع كشاف LED
LP-8M.construction: Hot-dip galvanized octagonal steel pole on concrete base, single-arm LED street luminaire
LP-8M.maintenance: Quarterly lamp and photocell check; galvanizing inspection every 5 years

LP-10M.name: Street lighting pole 10 m, double-arm LED
LP-10M.nameAr: عمود إنارة شارع ١٠ م بذراعين LED
LP-10M.construction: Hot-dip galvanized steel pole on concrete base, double-arm LED street luminaires
LP-10M.maintenance: Quarterly lamp and photocell check; galvanizing inspection every 5 years

PL-TIER.name: Tiered landscape planter (assumed use)
PL-TIER.construction: RC tiered planter with stone coping, drip irrigation, native drought-tolerant planting
PL-TIER.maintenance: Weekly irrigation check; seasonal planting maintenance
